info.title: Wallet APIs: walletAgeDays and walletInsights
info.description: Two inputs, one integer. Earliest finalized verified observation in explicitly covered histories. Ethereum mainnet is the only chain searched today; the accepted EVM-family aliases are not additional-chain coverage. The compact age cache admits at most 1,000,000 entries with persistent LRU eviction. Retained epochs have no TTL; a full cache replaces the least recently used entry on insertion. walletInsights is a separate Ethereum-only endpoint returning short-lived pinned balances, raw nonce, code profile and provenance-preserving AnChain labels. It does not include age or authorize withdrawals. Both cache databases default to a one-million-entry limit; successful reads and writes refresh recency. Insights snapshot and label rows share their database limit and keep their existing 15-second and 300-second TTLs.

servers.description: Local standalone service; not deployed to the AnChain production API

get.summary: Return completed days since first observed blockchain activity
get.description: Select an EVM address family. Current coverage is Ethereum mainnet only, including when blockchain=polygon, base, or another accepted EVM alias. Successful output is one JSON integer based on a finalized verified observation. The minimum is over available covered histories and remains a lower bound, not a globally complete birthday. An uncached request uses a shared 2.6-second application budget; missing data returns an error instead of extending the wait. Cached age epochs have no TTL but can be evicted by LRU at the one-million-entry database limit. Successful reads or writes refresh recency; an evicted address requires discovery again.

200.description: A bare integer: completed days since the earliest finalized verified observation found in covered histories. No balance, count, nonce or response envelope.

Cache-Control.description: Application-managed epoch caching; HTTP intermediaries must not cache responses.

X-Wallet-Age-Coverage.description: Chains actually searched by this family namespace. Every accepted selector currently covers Ethereum mainnet only.

X-Wallet-Age-Basis.description: Age of observed blockchain activity, not private-key creation.

X-Wallet-Age-Quality.description: Earliest verified observed activity is a lower bound on age; complete first occurrence is not proven.

X-Wallet-Age-Cache.description: hit reuses a retained epoch with zero provider calls; miss performs discovery and admits the new entry, evicting the least recently used entry if full; bypass serves without caching when storage is temporarily unavailable. Successful reads and writes refresh recency. Recency alone does not alter the epoch; an earlier verified observation may still improve it.

X-Wallet-Age-Finalized.description: Successful ages require a finalized verified canonical observation.

X-Wallet-Age-Evidence.description: Source agreement for this live lookup, or cached canonical evidence. Cached epochs do not retain quorum counts.

X-Wallet-Age-Sources.description: Distinct live positive history providers; zero on cached-canonical because the compact cache stores epochs only.

get.summary: Return pinned balances, nonce, code profile and AnChain labels
get.description: Ethereum mainnet only. Accepts eth, ethereum and eth-mainnet case-insensitively. Runs pinned RPC snapshot discovery and AnChain labels concurrently under a 2.6-second application budget. Paid Alchemy/QuickNode are preferred with three public RPC fallbacks. Native ETH and the fixed USDC/USDT/DAI balances are exact raw strings. HTTP 200 may be partial; inspect status and components. This endpoint never includes wallet age or an authorization to withdraw. Unknown labels are not a safe verdict. Snapshot and label entries share a persistent LRU cache with a default one-million-entry database limit. Expired entries are removed before fresh LRU victims. Reads refresh recency without extending component TTLs or capture times.

200.description: Complete or partial insights. Partial data is explicit; no missing value becomes zero. All example values are illustrative, not live results.

Cache-Control.description: Application-controlled short caches; intermediaries do not cache this result.

X-Wallet-Insights-Coverage.description: Actual chain coverage. No EVM-family folding for mutable insights.

X-Wallet-Insights-Cache.description: hit means both component caches hit; mixed means exactly one; miss means neither.

warnings: Risk labels unavailable within request budget.

503.description: Normal component unavailability returns the insights object with status unavailable. An unexpected framework failure or an unconfigured route handler can return the JSON string unknown. Neither is a safe verdict.

HeaderApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
HeaderApiKeyAuth.description: Required only when WALLET_CHECK_API_KEY is configured on the local service. Otherwise age requests do not require authentication.

blockchain.description: Case-insensitive family selector. Accepted EVM aliases share one Ethereum-only coverage namespace today; unknown well-formed selectors return 501. A polygon value is not a Polygon-specific lookup.

address.description: Regex-only EVM address validation. EIP-55 checksum and ownership are not checked. Normalized to lowercase after validation.

WalletAgeDays.description: floor((current_epoch_seconds - first_observed_epoch_seconds) / 86400), recomputed on every response. The retained epoch has no TTL and the number of days grows; LRU can evict the entry, causing a later lookup to rediscover an observation. Zero requires a real finalized observation less than one day old, not missing history.

blockchain.description: Actual chain selector. Only eth, ethereum and eth-mainnet are implemented, case-insensitively. EVM and Polygon aliases accepted by walletAgeDays are deliberately unsupported here.

address.description: Regex-only EVM address validation. EIP-55 checksum and ownership are not checked. Normalized to lowercase after validation.

InsightsBlock.description: One pinned chain state; balance, nonce, code and token calls use this block. Cached snapshots retain the original block.

balanceRaw.description: Exact integer in raw units, encoded as a decimal string. Null means unavailable, never an assumed zero.

InsightsTokenBalance.description: Fixed configured token: USDC, USDT or DAI on Ethereum mainnet. No arbitrary-token discovery or portfolio valuation.

InsightsCodeProfile.description: Descriptive execution profile, not an ownership or safety classification. Empty code does not prove an EOA; EIP-7702 EOAs can have delegation code.

InsightsLabel.description: Source-provided category with provenance. OSINT association is not a verified malicious verdict; no risk score or safe verdict is derived.

checkedAt.description: UTC ISO timestamp, or null when unavailable.

providerVerdictTime.description: Provider-supplied verdict time if present. The local fetch does not invent one.

InsightsRiskLabels.description: AnChain GET /api/intel/address/label, proto=eth. Empty explicit labels or unaffiliated attribution never imply safe; provider/config/deadline failures retain null labels.

capturedAt.description: UTC ISO timestamp, or null when unavailable.

expiresAt.description: UTC ISO timestamp, or null when unavailable.

InsightsCacheComponent.description: Independent component freshness in a shared, bounded LRU database. Snapshots keep a 15-second TTL and labels keep a 300-second TTL. Successful reads refresh recency but do not extend expiresAt or change capturedAt. Expired entries are removed before fresh LRU eviction; one address may use two entries. checkedAt on the overall response does not replace capturedAt or block time.

checkedAt.description: UTC ISO timestamp, or null when unavailable.

balanceRaw.description: Exact integer in raw units, encoded as a decimal string. Null means unavailable, never an assumed zero.

accountNonce.description: Raw account nonce as an exact decimal string. It is not total transactions, incoming transactions, or an exact outgoing count; EIP-7702 authorization processing can also increment it.

WalletInsightsResponse.description: Separate from walletAgeDays: no age field, derived risk score, or allow-withdrawal verdict. HTTP 200 may be partial; clients must inspect component status. Native/token balances and raw nonce remain exact decimal strings.
